topic_thesis: The illusion of saving ₹2 on cheap Russian petrol masks a brewing 100% US secondary tariff that threatens to crush India's $86.5B export economy and double consumer goods prices.
strategic_angle: Exposing the geopolitical 'discount' myth: while consumers celebrated negligible fuel price drops, US sanction bills are laying the groundwork to slap 100% retaliatory tariffs on Indian textiles, gems, and IT hardware, offloading macro diplomatic risks directly onto middle-class jobs and consumer inflation.
key_statistic: ₹2 petrol discount vs 100% tariff on $86.5 Billion Indian exports
target_emotion: Outrage at government macro-spin and sudden realization of personal pocket risk
pinned_comment_text: Did saving ₹2 on petrol actually set India up for a 100% import/export tariff shock? Tell us your take below, or comment 'TARIFF' to get our breakdown on how this hits your salary and consumer prices! 💬👇

source_signal: ZERO1 BY ZERODHA: US Secondary Tariffs & Russian Crude Reality Check
